claims.sentence: This study was designed to investigate the protective role of taurine supplementation against cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity. Methods: Male Wistar rats were divided into six groups and treated as follows: (1) saline-treated control drinking tap water, (2) saline-treated plus taurine-supplemented (1.5% taurine in the drinking water), (3) saline-treated plus taurine-depleted (3% β-alanine in the drinking water), (4) cisplatin-treated, CDDP 6 mg/kg intraperitoneally, (5) taurine-supplemented plus CDDP-treated and (6) taurine-depleted plus CDDP-treated.
